title: Share of world population in countries without official metric adoption

source.name: Countries that don't use the metric system
source.publisher: NIST / CIA World Factbook compilation; UN population estimates

notes: The United States, Liberia, and Myanmar are the only countries that have never officially adopted the metric system (NIST, CIA World Factbook). Their combined population is roughly 410 million against a world population of about 8.1 billion in 2026 -- about 5%. Illustrative: the percentage is calculated here from those two separately-sourced official figures, not quoted directly from a single publisher.
